tei:div.tei:p: "$ (71)༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid zin bris snying po gsal ba'i sgron me bdud rtsi'i nying khu chos sku mdzub tshugs su ngo sprod pa bzhugs/

(72)༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi hūm̐/ nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de la 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs bcud rdo rje 'chang chen po nas rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag gi bar du brgyud pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa byin rlabs kyi drod dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thun mong ma yin pa thob par byed pa'i thabs bka' brgyud rin po che'i bzhed srol ma nyams pa'i phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes grags pa 'di nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dang gsum/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ las 'bras bsam (73)pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ de'ang dam pa'i chos yang dag pa zhig nyams su len par byed na/ dper na seng ge'i 'o ma de snod phal par blugs na snod chag cing 'o ma chud zos la 'gro ba ltar snod dam rten phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ rten gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur ba ni dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che yin la/ da lam 'di lta bu'i mi lus rin po che rnyed pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang*/ 'di yang sngon tshogs mang po bsags/ mi dge ba bcu srog dang bsdos nas bsrungs/ dge ba bcu dang du blangs/ bsod nams dpag med bskrun pa'i mthu kho nas rnyed pa ma gtogs stabs legs kyis rnyed pa'am rgyu med par zhar byung gis rnyed pa lta bu ni ma yin pas rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka'/ gyang logs la sran ma gtor ba chags pa'am/

rgya mtsho chen por shing bug pa gcig pa zhig bskyur/ de na rus sbal gnas pa lo brgya brgya na mgo nyang tsam byas pa shing gi bu gar ske chud pa'am/ u dum+ba ra'i (74)me tog rnyed pa srid mtha' ma bkag tsam ma gtogs dkon pa de bzhin du dpe'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka'/ ngan song gsum sa chen po'i rdul tsam/ mi lus tsam po ba'ang sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di rdul phran tsam gyi tshod yin/ de'ang mi dge ba spyod pa shas che/ dge ba spyod pa shas chung bas ngan song du skye ba mang zhing*/ spyir mtho ris de'i nang nas dge ba bsgrub tu yod pa'i mi lus thob pa shin tu dkon zhing nyung bas grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka'/ 'di lta bu'i lus da lam rnyed pa 'di'ang rnyed dka' zhing 'jig sla bas da res mi lus stong log tu song na/ tshe phyi ma ngan song sogs su skyes na thar med kyi dong du tshud pa yin snyam du skad cig kyang ma yengs par brtson pa drag pos dge sbyor la gnad du bsnun nas lam sna zin pa zhig mi byed re snyam pa'i zhe dam dang rgyud la ci 'drer bya ba dang blo sna chos la bsgyur gang thub bya'o// thun gcig / gnyis pa mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ mi rtag pa ma bsgom na tshe 'di la blo mi log /de ma log na 'jig rten chos brgyad spong mi nus pas 'khor ba las mi grol zhing nyams rtogs khyad par can mi skye'o// des na de'i gnyen por mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di dang por chags tshul/ bar du gnas tshul/ mtha' mar lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par 'jig la/ dus snga phyi yang snga dro phyi dro nyin gung mtshan sogs skad cig rer yang mi brtan zhing*/ nam zla yang dgun dpyid dbyar ston sogs 'gyur zhing mi rtag la/ des na 'dus byas thams cad 'jig cing 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ nang bcud kyi sems can kyang*/ skyes tsam dang*/

byis pa chung ngu dang*/ dar la babs pa dang*/ rgas 'khog thams cad mthar 'chi ba las ma 'das/ 'chi ba'ang nam 'chi cha (75)med/ de ring sang tsam mi 'chi ba'i gding med/ da lta gson por yod bdo la/ gza'/ dug /mtshon/ me/ chu/ g.yang la sogs pa'i rkyen nges pa med pa zhig gis blo bur du tshe'i dus byas nas ro ru song ba'ang mang la/ yang ji tsam tshe ring na lo brgya las mi thub la/ de'ang tshe'i sum cha gcig song tshar 'dug pas 'chi bar gtug 'dug /rang re'i sngar gyi bla ma slob dpon grogs mched gnyen nye 'brel grong mi khyim mtshes de tsam zhig 'chi lugs kyis glo bur du shi ba'am nad kyis yun ring mnar/ na tsha zug rngu sdug bsngal bsam las 'das pa myong bzhin 'jigs shing skrag na yang bya thabs dang bslu thabs med par 'chi lugs de bzhin byas song*/ shi nas 'phrad dbang yang med/ gar song cha med chu nang rdo 'phangs pa bzhin 'bral mi phod cing rjes med du song*/ ro de ni dur sa zhig tu bskyal te langs med du gtor/ sems ni gang du song dang da lta gang du skye mi shes par 'dug /rang yang de 'dra ba zhig las ma 'das pas ci drag da lta rang shi na ci 'dra snyam pas/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma sgrub pa thams cad smyon pa zang ma yin 'dug /bshas rar khrid pa'i sems can dang 'dra 'dug pa la/ da lta rgyun ring sdod grabs dang*/ chos brgyad dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi ngang du btang na 'di las sdug bsngal ba med pas tshe 'di'i 'dun ma thams cad ci red la btang*/ tshe phyi ma 'don gcig mi sgrub re snyam pa'i 'dar yed yed kyi ngang nas rnam g.yeng la blo mi 'jug par tshe blos btang nas mi tshe sgrub pa la 'bad pa'i zhe dam dang*/ rgyud la ci 'drer byas blo sna thung sbud sbud bya'o// des na 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom pa dang por gal che ste/ sngon shi ba rnams la bsam/ rang yang 'di las ma 'das pas 'chi tsa na longs (76)spyod snyan grags sogs thams cad dang 'grogs dbang med par shul du lus pas phan pa mi 'dug

/de dus phan pa ni chos kho na red snyam du dang por chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du gal che ste nam 'chi cha med tsa na dal bar sdod pa'i long med pas chos la bskul ba'i lcag byed/ mtha' mar gal che ste 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'am/ 'chi ba'i rang bzhin don dam bden pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de rtogs par 'gyur ro// de bas 'di nyid sgom pa la nan tan bya'o// thun gnyis/ gsum pa las 'bras bsam pa ni/ 'o na shi nas rgyang 'phen pa'i lugs bzhin du mar me shi ba ltar med par 'gyur ba'am/ 'dir skye rang dbang 'dus pa zhig yin na de kas chog kyang*/ de ltar ma yin par las gang byas kyi rjes su 'brangs te skye ba len dgos/ de'ang zhe sdang gis gtso bor kun nas bslangs te las bsags pa dang*/ yul gnyen po la sdig bsags pa dang*/ mi dge ba bcu drag po dang grangs mang por spyad na dmyal bar skye/ 'dod chags kyis gtso bor kun nas bslangs te las bsags pa dang*/ yul 'bring la brten nas sdig bsags pa dang*/ mi dge bcu 'bring du spyad pa dang*/ grangs kyang bar ma tsam spyad pas yi dwags su skye/ gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te las bsags pa dang*/ yul phal pa dang dman pa la brten nas sdig bsags pa dang*/ mi dge ba chung ngu spyad pa dang*/ grangs kyang nyung ngur spyad na dud 'gror skye/ zag bcas kyi dge ba che 'bring chung gsum du spyad pas lha dang lha min mi rnams su skye'o// des na rang gis las gang bsags pa de bar mdor chud mi 'dza' bar rang thog tu gnas/ thig drang por btab pa bzhin 'chug pa med par myong bas dus rtag tu rang gi sgo gsum la brtag dpyad byas te dge bar gyur pa (77)rnams la dga' ba sgom/ de chud mi 'dza' ba'i phyir/ sems can gyi don du bsngo ba rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab/ mi dge ba rnams la gnod 'gyod kyi bshags sdom tshul bzhin byed/ sdig ltung dang zhag tu mi 'grogs par phyir bcos la 'bad pa gal che/

nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i bsam pa nam skyes 'bur 'joms byas nas 'di'i dbang du gtong re snyam pa'i zhe dam byed cing dge sdig spang blang go ma log par lag len la thebs par bya'o// thun gsum/ bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin las mi dge ba dang dge ba ci rigs spyad pa'i 'bras bus rim gyis ngan song du skyes na dmyal ba tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe nyi 'khor ba gnyis te bco brgyad yod pa de dag so so na sdug bsngal mi bzad pa dpag dka' ba sdug bsngal kho na ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs med la/ tsha dmyal brgyad du skyes na da lta thug pa tsam zhig gis kha tshig na tsha na ji tsam 'dug /khro chu khol mas nang khrol thams cad bsreg cing zangs kyi nang du 'tshod pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong na ji ltar bya/ tsher ma tsam zug kyang zur gzer 'di tsam 'dug pa la/ s+t+wa gri dang sog le me 'bar bas lus tshal bar gtub cing gshag par byed pa lta ci smos/ gos cung zad srab kyang grang reg ci tsam yod/ grang dmyal du skyes na gos med gcer bur 'khyag sbubs rlung mi 'thad pas nyen pa'i nang du tshud nas lus dum bur gas pa sogs sdug bsngal tshad bzung med par myong bas de ltar sdug bsngal/ yi dwags su skyes na da lta lto nyin gcig ma myong yang rkyen mi theg na/ der skyes na mi'i zla ba la zhag tu brtsis pa'i lo lnga brgya'i bar du chu thig pa gcig dang zan rdog gcig kyang za rgyu mi rnyed/ gal te zos kyang mgrin par mi thar lto bas mi theg /nang khrol me 'bar bas (78)bsreg pas sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro bying na gnas pa phyi'i rgya mtsho na yod pa dang*/ kha 'thor ba lha mi'i yul na yod pa rnams kyang gcig gis gcig za ba mi khyag bzhin khal 'gel/ mi nus bzhin rmos rmo sha gcod/ sna 'bigs/ bsha' ba sogs dang*/ nam mkhar 'phur ba'i bya bye'u/

sa la rgyu ba'i ri dwags sogs dud 'gro'i rigs thams cad mi sogs mthong tshad gshed ma khor lag can du mthong nas bsad dogs pa sogs da lta mi'i lus la mdung thung lnga brgyas bsnun pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal yod pas der skyes kyang sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal ni/ sems kyi sdug bsngal dmyal ba 'bum 'gyur las che/ nya bye tshan la bsgres pa dang mtshungs/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyis rgyud tshig pa'i rang bzhin can lus rmas pa sogs sdug bsngal gong dang 'dra/ mi la skye ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ mi'i mngal na gnas dus ma bgrang na ris non pa tsam/ ltog na dbyang la btags pa tsam/ kha zas tsha po zos na chu tshan la btsos pa tsam dang*/ grang mo la 'khyag sbubs su bcug pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal/ skye dus ri chen po'i bar du bcar ba tsam/ thang la lhung tshe tsher dong du bskyur ba tsam/ phru ma bshus tshe pags pa bshus pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal/ de nas rim gyis rgas pa na kha'i so ni bud/ mgo ni skya bor song*/ mig ni 'grib/ rna ba ni 'on/ sked pa ni sgur/ langs na 'then pa 'dra/ bsdad na lhung ba 'dra/ rkang pas lus po mi theg /kun gyis brnyas bcos byed pa sogs sdug bsngal/ na ba so na ba tsam la'ang bzod blag med na gzhan lta ci smos/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yang mal gyi tha mar nyal/ zas kyi tha ma za/ nye du 'grel pas mtha' bskor/ gtam gyi tha ma 'or skyed byed/ thim rim dang bstun nas lus sa 'og tu (79)lhung ba snyam byed/ ci bya gtol dang bral te dbugs sna dang kha nas yang yang bsho ba'i ngang phyir ldog med par khrog gis chad 'jigs skrag dpag tu med pa myong yang bslu thabs med pas sdug bsngal/ gzhan yang yod pa bsrung mi thub/ med pa btsal bas mi rnyed/ dgra dang phrad dogs/ gnyen dang bral dogs/ bu ma phog dogs/ bu mo ma brdzangs dogs/ mnga' ris phyogs ris snyan grags nyams dogs pa sogs sdug bsngal/

des na 'khor ba'i bde 'byor ni tshangs pa brgya byin/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i go 'phang thob kyang phan pa med/ dper na mi btson dong du tshud pa de 'bros pa'i bsam pa ma gtogs skad cig kyang sdod mi 'dod zhen chags med par 'di nas nam thar ram snyam pa bzhin du bdag gis 'khor ba sdug bsngal ma gtogs pa bde ba skad cig kyang med pa 'di las me 'obs sam btson dong ngam/ ngan skyugs kyi 'dam nas 'bros pa bzhin du ci thar byas te 'jig rten chos brgyad dang*/ 'khor ba'i bde 'byor sgrub re shi snyam pa'i zhe dam dang nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa bya'o// thun bzhi/ 'di dag ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro yin la/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyud snod du rung zhing ci byas thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ 'o na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de las thar ba'i thabs dang skyabs thub pa gang yin na yul dkon mchog gsum la brten nas sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam gyi grogs su bzung nas lam bgrod dgos la/ mthar thug (80)skyabs thub pa ni sangs rgyas kho na yin la/ de thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'dus pa yin pas de la skyabs zhu/ skyabs zhus nas sems can gyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub dgos la/ de'ang sems can thams cad pha mar shes/ de'i drin dran pa drin lan gzhal ba'i bsam pas de rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la sbyor phyir bdag gis sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing smon lam mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang de ltar bslab par bya snyam pas sems bskyed/

mdor na bsgom bya ni dkon mchog ngo bo gcig la rnam pa lngar mtshon byed du mdun du rgya mtsho chen po mtha' ne'u gseng gis bskor ba'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi shing gi rnam pa'am shing sdong gang gsal ba rtsa ba gcig la yal ga lngar gyes pa'i dbus kyi lte bar pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar gyi na bza' gsol ba mtshan dpes spras pa zhig la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad tho brtsegs sam khrom tshogs su bskor nas bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi yal ga'i steng na gdan pad nyi dang ro gdan nam/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng na dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'am yi dam gang 'os la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi yal ga la seng ge'i khri dang pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng na ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu chos dkon mchog pu sti brtsigs pa ltar gser gdong khra chem gyis rang la bstan pa/ g.yon du nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs theg pa chen po'i dge (81)'dun dang*/ rab 'byor kun dga' bo mchog zung sogs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams khrom tshogs pa bzhin bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i gdan mtshams su chos skyong srung ma/ bar mtshams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin gsal gdab/ mtsho 'gram gyi ne'u gseng gi steng du bdag nyid kyis gtsos nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod pa'i 'dren dpon rang res byas te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed par bya snyam du bsam nas skyabs 'gro'i tshig ci rigs dang*/ sems bskyed tshul yang gong du bshad pa bzhin gsal btab nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// zhes sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sogs dar drags la gsal thebs pa 'don sgom yid la ci 'drer bya/ mthar skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ skyabs yul gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur snyam du sgom/

thun lnga / gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa mtshan dpes spras pa bsgom nas/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos (82)skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad thal phung la chu btang ba bzhin nag ldur ldur dud khu'i rnam par bshang gci'i lam dang ba spu'i bu ga dang mthe bong sogs nas phyir thon/ lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur par bsam zhing ngag tu yig brgya ci nus 'don/ mthar rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag yod do gsungs nas bka'i gnang ba byin/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur bsams nas dar cig sems ma bcos par rang lugs su glod la bzhag go / thun drug / gsum pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal gcig lag tu thogs pa la 'bru 'dzin bzhin pas rdul phyi bskor du lan gsum phyi/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul pas bsdus pa'i ma dag pa thams cad stong par sbyangs par bsam/

nang bskor du lan gsum skor/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par bsam/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu bkod/ maṇ+ḍal gzhal yas khang du tshom bu skyabs yul gyi skabs bzhin dkon mchog lnga tshoms su bskyed/ mchod pa sla ba'i ched zhal thams cad rang la bstan par bsams (83)la mchod shoms kyi dbus su bzhag /gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bzhin 'bru 'dzin pas phyi skor du lan gsum phyis/ bdag gzhan gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par bsam/ tshom bu phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du bkod la/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma dang*/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal gyi cho gas rigs pa dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga 'dod yon lnga sogs phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs nang gi mchod pa dang*/ rig ma bcu drug la sogs bde ba'i mchod pa gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ de thams cad kyang mchod bya mchod byed gnyis su med pa'i ngang las 'bul ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ste mchod rdzas ji snyed cig gis mchod par bsam/ de ltar phul ba'i mthus tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing nyams rtogs phul du byung ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// de'i ngang nas dar gcig ma bcos pa'i dang du mnyam par bzhag go / thun bdun/ bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang yi dam gyi lha bde mchog lta bur gsal ba'i spyi bor rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de dge slong gi cha lugs zhwa nag gser mdangs can thabs shes dbyer med mtshon phyir rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol nas 'dzin pa sogs thun bzhi'i gsol 'debs nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed nas gsol ba 'debs kyang de nyid kyi sgo nas byed/ yang na rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma de sku mdog de ka'am yi dam gyi rnam pa gang mos zhig tu bsgoms nas de'i spyi bo nas rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su sgom pa'am/

yang na khrom tshogs su bsgoms nam de la tshad bzung med pa'i mos gus thun mong (84)min pa dengs pa byas nas/ dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// bdag la dbang bzhi bskur ba dang*// rgyud bzhi smin dang phrin las bzhi'i// dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ khyad par nyams rtogs stsol med du// rgyud la da lta skye ba dang*// khyed kyi go 'phang rab 'grub nas// 'gro ba de la 'god par shog /ces sogs gsol 'debs dar drags la yun ring ba snang ba 'gyur nges su bya/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi skur bsgoms te phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// kun khyab chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= zhes sogs ji ltar 'os pa'i gsol 'debs byas te/ bla ma las dbang bzhi len par spro na dkon mchog gsum 'dus kyi skur bsam pa la mos gus dung byas bla ma'i dpral ba mgrin pa thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po dmar po sngon po rnams rim gyis 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs rim sgom pa dang*/ dga' bzhi'i thabs shes snyoms 'jug sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku longs sku chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang bla ma'i sku'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer kha dog rnam pa lnga pa zhig 'phros/ rang gi lus thams cad la phog pas sgo gsum cha mnyam dang sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag

/(85)dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam rig stong dbyer med sgom par dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'am bde ba chen po'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas/ de nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung*/ thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur snyam pa'i ngang du dar cig ma bcos par bzhag go /'di shin tu gal che bas nan tan du bsgom/ sngon 'gro bzhi po gang dang gang nyams su len pa'i tshe'ang thun bzhi 'bad rtsol gyis 'don bzhin dus rgyun du ma bral bar nyams su blangs pas rmi lam du'ang nyams su blangs pa'i snang ba byung na thun 'dril ba'i tshad yin la/ tshogs 'phel ba dang sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags rnams dngos dang rmi lam du'ang 'byung bas 'bad pas nyams su blang ngo*// thun brgyad/ gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la sgrub rkyen bzhi las/ mi rtag pas rgyud bskul zhing 'khor ba'i chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid mthong bas yid 'byung zhing zhen log bya btang la nan tan byed pas rgyu'i rkyen dang*/ gang zag brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bde gshegs bka'i bla ma/ don dam chos nyid kyi bla ma/ snang ba brda'i bla ma sogs yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa bdag po'i rkyen yin pas de ltar bsten pa dang*/ 'dir tha snyad rtog btags kyi grub mtha' la phyogs zhen gyi cha thams cad rbad bcad de thams cad dang mi 'gal zhing*/ thams cad las khyad du 'phags pa gdod ma'i gnas lugs chos nyid kyi rang babs so zhes nges pa bskyed de bsgom bya ma 'khrul ba dmigs rkyen yin pas de ltar nges par bya ba dang*/ sgom la zhen pa bral ba'i sgo nas nan tan snying rus bskyed pa ma gtogs bdag gis sgom par byed do// byas so// bya'o// skyes na legs ma skyes na ma legs snyam pa sogs re (86)dogs kyi mtshan ma dang bral bas gang shar skyong ba de ma thag pa'i rkyen yin pas de ltar nges par bya ba ste sgrub rkyen bzhi po de nyid kyi mjug thog tu nyams rtogs thams cad rtsol med du skye bar 'gyur ro// de dag ni khyad par gyi sngon 'gro ste sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// sgrub rkyen gyi thun 'di rnams thun gcig tu bsgril te thun dgu'o// bzhi pa dngos gzhi la/

zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis/ dang po la lus gnad dang sems gnad gnyis/ dang po lus gnad ni/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du bca'/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyang*/ mgrin pa yid tsam dgug /lce ya rkan la sbyar ba'am rang babs/ mig gdangs zum mnyam par sna rtse'i thad sor bzhi'i bar snang la blta/ de ltar bcas pa'ang dogs pa gcum pa mi bde ba ma yin pa/ bde 'bol ler 'gro ba zhig bcas pas rim bzhin thur sal gyi rlung dbang du 'du ba dang*/ chu rlung dbu mar chud pa dang*/ me mnyam dang sa rlung dbu mar tshud pa dang*/ khyab byed dang me rlung dbu mar chud pa dang*/ srog 'dzin dang rlung gi rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i dgos pa yod la/ der ma zad lus gnad de ltar bcas pas rtsa rlung las su rung ba sogs yon tan dpag med 'char zhing lus gnad bcas pa kho nas kyang nyams rtogs rang 'bar la yong bas lus gnad de bzhin byas te/ dang por rlung ro cung zad bus/ de nas rang bab la rtsol ba dang bral bar sngon 'gro rnams rags rim gsal btab ste rang gi ci bder bzhag go /de'i nang nas sems gnad la spyi dang so so ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod mi bsam/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngun bsus te 'di bya'o byed do zhes mi mno// da lta ba la rtsis gdab bsal bzhag med par thol skyes kyi tha mal shes pa de (87)nyid kyi ngang la spang blang re dogs bzo bcos gang yang mi byed par so ma lhug pa rang ga ba de nyid kyi ngang la ci gnas su bzhag go / thun bcu/ gnyis pa so so ba ni/ de la sems gnas ma nus na shing dum bu'am rde'u phra mo zhig mdun du bzhag nas de la sems 'dzin pa dang gcig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshan dpes spras pa bshams pa'am yid kyis sprul te byings rmugs 'thibs gsum byung na dbu'i gtsug tor ram mdzod spu/ rgod 'thor byung na lte ba'am zhabs kyi 'khor lo dang gdan mtshams/

bying rgod med tshe sku ril po'am thugs ka'i dpal be'u la rtse gcig gtad de bzhag /mtshan bzang rnams yid kyis re re nas yas nas mar dang*/ mas nas yar bsngo bgrang byed bzhin gsal btab pa dang gnyis/ mar me sor bzhi pa lta bu la gtad pa dang gsum/ bu ga nam mkha' stong pa'i cha lag mthil tsam mam rgya che chung ci rigs pa la gtad pa dang bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūm̐ sngon po gsum mdun du bris te de la 'dzin pa dang lnga/ mdun du thig le dkar dmar sngon po sogs ci rigs bris pa'am/ mdun du dmigs pa la sems 'dzin pa sogs mdor na gzugs ji ltar 'os pa la 'dzin pa dang drug ste/ 'di 'dra'i rigs mang yang 'di tsam gyis 'dus shing 'di rnams 'dzin gang bde ba zhig la bzung la zin na de kas chog /thams cad mthar chags su 'dzin dgos pa'i nges pa med/ 'jog tshul gshis cir yang ma grub par blo gang du'ang mi 'dzin par sems de gnas na zhog /'gro na thong*/ gnyer kha ma byed par yan du chug /sgom snyam pa dang*/ mi sgom snyam pa dang*/ sems gnas su ri ba dang*/ ma gnas dogs pa sogs rnam rtog gi mtshan ma thams cad rbad bcad/ dmigs (88)rten 'gul ba'am grum pa'am mig sbrid pa lta bu byung na 'phro bzhag nas smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i bar snang la blta zhing sems rang lugs su glod la bzhag go /'di sgom gyi gtad so gang yang mi bya ma yengs pa tsam bya zhing byings rmugs kyis ma gos par rig pa dang sing nge ba la tsan ne bzhag go /sgom dang bzang gyes thun thung la grangs mang ba la gsal dwangs brod pa dang bcas pas yang yang mnyam par bzhag cing yang yang 'phro bcad ma sun par bya ba la bslab par gal che/ thun bcu gcig / de la sems zin pa dang*/ rna ba'i yul gyi sgra/ sna'i yul gyi dri/ lce'i yul gyi ro// lus kyi yul gyi reg bya sogs thos tshad la'ang rim gyis bzung ste de la sgra dri sogs la sgra lhang nge ba dri chil le ba de tsam la sems gtad de ma yengs par dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ste rang babs su bzhag pa ma gtogs bzang ngan che chung sogs kyi dpyad pa gang yang mi byed gang rung la sems 'dzin te/

gsal bdo bar mtshams bcad de ngal gso/ nyog mi 'jug /thun bar thams cad du dran thag ma chad tsam dang*/ mig lta stangs sna rtser dbab/ lus 'gro 'dug /ngag smra brjod rnams drag shul dang mang po mi bya/ yid kyis mtshan bcas kyi bsam mno rnams kyang rgyun bcad de rim gyis mnyam bzhag la goms 'jug / thun bcu gnyis/ yang nang du sems 'dzin pa'i bying rgod byung na de sel thabs la snying gar yi dam mam/ bla ma gang mos som/ yang na bla ma'i ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu la sems 'dzin la/ bying rmugs byung na snying gar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig snying gnas spyi bor rgyang thon bar snang la ye re gnas par bsam/ gos 'thug pa dang nyi ma me sogs drod kyi rigs spang*/ zas bcud can mi bsten/ chu lcag btab/ (89)rlung dang bser bu phog pa dang*/ ri 'gor blta ba dang sdod/ rgod pa dang 'thor ba sogs la snying gar pad+ma nag po kha mthur du lta ba nas thig le nag po zhig ba thag chad pa bzhin du chu lam nas thon/ gdan mtshams gser gyi sa gzhir thim par bsam la gos dang spyod lam sogs gong las go bzlog ste drod la bsor/ bying rgod med pa'i shes pa so na gnas dus thad ka'i gang 'os sam/ nyi grib mtshams su thig le'am/ rdzas sngon po chung ngu zhig la lta stangs dang dmigs pa gtad/ de rnams la'ang dang por thig le sogs 'di lta bu sgom snyam du gsal thebs nges dang 'phen pa drag po btang*/ de rjes gsal na rab/ ma gsal kyang 'di lta bu yod snyam pa tsam yid yul la byas te brtag gzhig sogs mi byed par de nyid kyi steng du rang babs su ma yengs tsam du rang lugs su bzhag /gsal bdo bar mtshams bcad la thun thung la grangs mang bar bya'o// thun bcu gsum/ yang rten med la sems 'dzin pa ni/ rim gyis sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bar gcig la gcig thim ste stong chen zhig tu gyur snyam pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i mthongs kyi stong sang nge ba de la mig ha re bltas nas dmigs pa gtad/

yod med yin min sogs gang yang yid la mi byed par 'bol le lhod de glod la ma yengs pa'i rgyang so tsam bkod nas bzhag /skad cig kyang yengs su mi 'jug pa khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa lta bu/ g.yo 'gul med pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu dang*/ rtsol sgrub med pa khyung nam 'phar gcod pa lta bu dang*/ re dogs dang bral ba seng ge gangs la gnas pa bzhin bzhag pas ma yengs par rnam rtog mi yong*/ nam yengs tsa na rnam rtog cig yer gyis yong*/ de byung ma thag ngos zin par byas te/ chags sdang rmongs gsum (90)sogs mi dge ba dang sbyin sogs dge ba lung ma bstan sogs rnam rtog ci 'dra byung yang dgag sgrub spang blang dga' mi dga' gang yang mi byed par ngos bzung la de nyid kyi steng du ma yengs par bzhag la shes rab kyi mig gis blta/ rtog pa de sems 'dzin gyi rten tu byas te/ grims drag pa dang lhod drag pa'i skyon dang bral bar byas te gang du'ang ma lhung bar tsan ne bzhag go /

thun bcu bzhi/ des kyang ma zin na/ rlung la brten nas 'dzin pa la bum pa can dang*/ grangs la brten nas 'dzin pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rlung ro dgu bus rjes mar la chil gyis bzung*/ mchil ma mid pa dang mnyam du lte 'og tu mnan cing ci zin bzung*/ gtong dus rlung 'bud pa dang bstun re zhig 'og rlung rang sar bzhag /'di la legs par byang nas 'og rlung yar cung zad 'then/ bum pa can la bslab/ de nas rdub chung yang bya zhing*/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad kyi nang stong sang nge ba la sems gtad/ bar bar du smin mtshams la blta zhing glod/ ha cang 'grangs ches pa dang ltogs pa'i dus mi 'dzin/ tho rangs lta bur ci nus bzung*/ de bzhin mi chun na grangs la 'dzin pa ni/ rlung nang du rgyu ba dang gnas pa phyir dbyung ba gsum gcig tu brtsis pa'i thog mar nyer gcig tsam mam mthar brgya stong la sogs par yid kyis bsdong grang dang*/ sna sgo'i lam ma gtogs gzhan gang du'ang ma yengs par bya/ dmigs pa'i rnam grangs de rnams la gnas pa'i sna gcig nges par zin yong zhing*/ gang zag gi rigs gcig car ba dang*/ thod rgal ba dang*/ rim gyis pha gang yang srid pas de dag la 'char dka' sla yang ci rigs pa yong yang sgyid lug par mi bya bar bskyangs pas mi skye ba mi srid pas/ bla ma nyams myong can dang bstun nas (91)khrid pas gnas pa dang po ri gzar gyi 'babs chu lta bu/ gnyis pa chu bo dal 'babs lta bu/ tha ma mi g.yo ba rgya mtsho chen po lta bu gsum rim gyis 'char/ snga ma rnams las rnam rtog rags su song ba 'dra zhig yod yang de sngar ma tshor/ de mnyam par bzhag pas tshor ba yin pas ma sun par bskyangs pas mthar rnam rtog gang gis kyang g.yo ba med par rang shugs kyis 'char/ de ltar gnas pa gsum po la ma skyes kyang brtson 'grus bskyed/ grims lhod bzlog sgom spel nas byas pas skye la/ grims pas lus sems shes pa lta stangs thams cad bcun nas zam pa mda' gcig ma'i steng du 'gro ba ltar 'di sgom gyi gtad so med par phri li li bskur zhing 'jur 'debs thun thung bar bya/

glod pa ni 'khrul 'khor lta stangs sogs glod/ sems kho rang rang lugs su lhod glod/ bzo med bdag med gar thod thod du 'bol ler bzhag /rtsol sgrub bral ba bu chung ltos bgrangs pa ltar 'bol le bzhag nas ma yengs tsam gyis dran pa yud de ba bya/ de min gang yang mi bsam/ thun cung ring ba bya/ bzlog bsgom ni rnam rtog gang skyes pa de ka ngos bzung nas sku drin can du bltas/ spang blang re dogs thams cad dor la ngos zin par byas/ ji tsam 'gyur kyang 'or che/ da dung yang ji tsam 'gyu yod pa 'gyus shig byas/ rjes su mi 'brang ngos kyang zin par byas dgag sgrub gang yang mi byed/ na tsha sdug bsngal nyon mongs drag po skyes kyang de bzhin blta bar byas pas rang zhi la 'gro'o// thun bco lnga/ de nas zhi gnas bskyed tshul dang ngo sprod ni/ de'ang sems 'dzin gyi mthus sems cung zad gnas pa dang rab tu gnas pa la zhi gnas zhes bya yi 'phro rkyen dang ma 'phrad par gyi na bar lus la la zhi gnas zhes mi bya/ zhi gnas ni sems nyon (92)mongs pa dang rnam rtog mtshan 'dzin rnam g.yeng gi spros pa nye bar zhi zhing dge ba'i ngo bor bying rgod dang bral bar sing nge bar rtse gcig tu gnas pa sngar gyi rtsol pa dang bcas pa de rtsol ba lam ltos pa sla la gu yangs ba skyod bde ba sgom pa las langs dus kyang sems gang du'ang mi 'gyu bar skor re sdod pa spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du shes pa dal la lhun chags pa snang ba bkrag med du long nge ba yul la ched du blos ma bcug na yul gyi spu ris mi zin/ brjed ngas che ru song ba 'dra ba bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ci rigs pa mthong*/ nyams mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yang mang po dang*/ rtags bcu sogs kyang ji ltar rigs pa 'char bas 'di bzhin rgyud la skyes na lhag mthong sogs yon tan thams cad skye ba'i gzhi yin/ 'di skabs su na tsha zug gzer sdug bsngal ma nyes pa'i kha yog kyang ji ltar rigs pa 'char ba rmi lam bzang ngan mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams sogs ji ltar skyes kyang chags sdang spangs te zhen 'khris med pa'i ngang nas/

brtson 'grus kyi skya bar nas bton bsgoms na yon tan bsam las 'das pas de ltar sgom pa la zhi gnas lteng po dang 'khyams po skyon can sogs dang bral ba'i zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa 'di bzhin rgyud la bsgrun pa dang nan tan snying por bya'o// 'di zhi gnas rkyang pa'i ngos 'dzin no// thun bcu drug / gnyis pa lhag mthong la blta ba dang ngo sprod pa gnyis/ dang po la gnas thog nas blta ba dang*/ 'gyu thog nas blta ba dang*/ snang thog nas blta ba dang lus sems gcig tha dad pa lta ba/ gnas 'gyu la blta ba dang lnga/ dang po ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar bca'/ lta stangs skabs 'dir gal che bas sngar las mtho tsam par snang gi dkyil lam thad kar tsham tshum (93)khyar khyur ya yo med par ha re blta/ sngon 'gro rags rim lam tsam gsal btab/ de nas sems rang lugs su glod/ de rjes sems gnas pa skyon med gsal le hrig ge bar gnas pa de'i ngang nas dran pa yud de ba byas la zhi gnas bzang bdo'i dus su sems de'i ngo bo kha dog gzugs dbyibs skye 'gags gnas gsum yod med ji ltar snyam du blta zhing gnas pa'i sems de lus kyi phyi nang gang 'dra zhig /kha dog dbyibs ji lta bu'i tshul du gnas blta/ 1 gnas pa de kha ma gtogs pa gzhan logs su shes rgyu e 'dug 2 /ci yang ngos gzung med pa'i stong pa cang med ri rwa 'dra zhig 'dug gar/ 3 gnas pa'i ngang nas ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal le sing nge bde 'bol le ba ngag tu smra mi shes pa la ngo shes pa zhig e 'dug 4 /gnas pa'i ngo bo de'ang lung ma bstan gyi shes pa nag thom me ba gang yang dran rgyu med pa/ gsal cha med pa zhig 'dug gam/ 5 gsal hrig ge rjen ne lhan ne gnas pa zhig 'dug 6 /'dir gnas lugs kyi mtshang yod pas go bskam po dang*/ chos skad mtho mtho dang*/ ma skyes kyang chos brgyad kyis skyes khab byas na rang gis rang bslus shing drin chung bas rdo rus gtugs te nang nas bcos min du shar ba'i sgom stobs kyis nyams su myong ba rnam rtog gi lhan pa btab pa ma yin pa'i myong rtogs/

7 yang ngal gso blta bar byas te rgyud thog tu khel nges shig byas te blta bar bya'o// thun bcu bdun/ gnyis pa 'gyu thog nas blta ba ni/ lus gnad sngon 'gro nas gnas pa blta ba yan rags rim tsam gsal btab nas sems gnas pa ston med de'i ngang la lhod glod la bzhag /de nas rnam rtog glo bur ba zhig skyes sam skyer bcug ste 'phros pa'i rnam rtog de'i ngo bo ji lta bu/ kha dog dbyibs ji lta bu'i tshul gyis (94)'phro/ 'di'i skye ba/ 'gags pa/ gnas pa gang 'gyus pa'i rtog pa de'i ngo bo la gal med du blta/ 1 rnam rtog ci mang dang nyon mongs pa dug gsum sogs kyi rtog pa skyes sam skyer bcug nas de la'ang sngar bzhin blta/ 2 rtog pa rang rang dang rtog pa 'phro ba'i yul dang*/ sngar phan gyi rtog pa'i sems la khyad ci 'dug blta/ 3 rtog pa de la blta dus su rtog pa thams cad stong nyid spros bral skye 'gags dang bral ba zhig gam/ 4 de la blta dus rtog pa skyes tshad rjes med du shig shig 'gro yin gda' 'am/ 5 rtog pa skyes tshad ngos bzung med par rang grol gsal rig rjen par e 'dug blta/ 6 phyi ma ltar na sngar gyi gnas pa'i steng gi gsal rig rjen pa dang*/ da res rtog pa'i steng du mthong ba'i gsal rig rjen pa gnyis la khyad par e 'dug /rtog pa skyes tshad ngos bzung med par shar 'dug na ngos bzung mi 'dug snyam rgyu zhig 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ 7 rtog pa tshur bkug nas gsal stong du bzhag pas gsal rig tu song ba yin nam/ 8 thol skyes kyi thog ma'i shes pa gang gis kyang ma bslad pa de ka'i ngo bo la bltas pas shar grol dus mnyam du song ba yin blta/ 9 'char tshul thun mong ma yin pa rgyud la khel nges su blta'o// thun bco brgyad/ gsum pa snang thog nas blta ba ni/ lus gnad sngon song rnams gsal tsam btab/ yul ka ba/ bum pa/ rtsig pa/ ri/ khang pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pa zhig la mig lta stangs gtang de de nyid la gcer gyis blta/

de thog cung zad glod la bzhag /yang blta'o// de bzhin du dbang po lnga'i yul gyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams la'ang ngo bo kha dog dbyibs/ skye 'gags gnas gsum sogs ji lta bu snyam du blta/ na tsha/ sdug bsngal/ tsha grang sogs/ thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa bcad la blta'o// de ltar bltas (95)bas snang ba de 'gags 'gro 'dug gam/ rang dang snang ba tha dad du snang ngam/ sems la snang ba tshur 'char ram/ sems kyis snang ba la snang ba'o snyam du phar bzung ba yin nam/ sems snang ba dang dbyer med/ yul med snang stong du lhang nge yod pa yin pa lta'o// yul la bltas pas yul de pha gir lam mer 'dug na de skad 'di'o snyam pa'i skad de ba zhig 'dug gam/ de skad snyam rgyu yang med par yul yang ma 'gags par thal le ba de la lta byed kyi sems de'ang 'dzin med shigs se bu chung lha khang mthong ba lta bu de gnyis gcig tha dad kyang med pa 'dra'o snyam rgyu yang med pa 'dra zhig 'dug /dang po ltar na de skad snyam pa de ga la blta'o// thun bcu dgu/ bzhi pa lus sems tha dad la blta ba ni/ 'o na lus sems gnyis gcig gam tha dad/ gcig na lus skye 'jig can dang sems skye 'jig med pa gnyis ga mi gcig /der ma zad/ lus bem po dang*/ sems shes pa gnyis kyang mi gcig /gcig na lus shi dus sems kyang shi bar 'gyur/ lus la tsher ma zug na sems la'ang zug par 'gyur la/ tha dad na lus la tsher ma zug pa lus sems gang gis tshor/ lus gcig pus tshor na ros kyang tshor bar 'gyur la/ sems kyis tshor na lus sems tha dad cing lus la zug rngu byung na sems kyis tshor tshe sa rdo la gnod pa byas na'ang sems la na tsha 'byung rigs pa las de ltar mi 'byung la/ des na legs par blta'o// de'ang byung tshor thams cad chu dang rlabs ltar shes par byas la blta'o// chos thun nyi shu pa/ lnga pa gnas 'gyu gnyis gcig gam tha dad la blta ba ni/

yang sems gsal stong gi ngang du sing nge ye re gnas dus kyi ngo bo la blta'o// yang rnam rtog gcig 'gyu ru bcug la de'i ngo bo la blta'o// de gnyis ngo bo gcig gam tha dad brtag /(96)tha dad na kha dog dbyibs ngo bo gang 'dra'i sgo nas tha dad/ de gnyis thang la skud pa gshib pa ltar shed mnyam mam/ 1 gnas pas lta ba la 'gyu ba shing rta lta bu'am/ 2 thag pa 'khyog pa ltar re mos su gnas dus mi 'gyu/ 'gyu dus mi gnas pa'am blta'o/ 3 /gcig na 'gyu ba ni mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu 'di yin gnas pa ni lhan ne gnas pa gnyis ji ltar gcig /gcig na gcig lugs lcags la gser 'gyur ltar gnas gyur nas gcig gam/ 4 chu dang 'o ma ltar 'dres te gcig gam/ 5 chu dang rlabs bzhin ngo bo la khyad med kyang re mos su 'char bzhin gnas dus su mi 'gyu/ 'gyu dus mi gnas gnyis ka'i ngo bo gsal stong gcig par 'dug 6 /phyi ma ltar ro snyam na rtog pa tshur bkug nas sgom la bzhag pas gsal stong du 'dug gam/ 7 yal rjes su'am/ 8 thol skyes gang shar thams cad rjes med shigs se 'gro 'dug blta'o/ 9 /de ltar bltas pas gnas 'gyu gtan la phabs so// blta ba'ang bu chung lha khang blta ba ltar blta'o// blta tshul 'di tsam la snying nas brtson pa bskyed/ zab zob dang go ba skam po la ma zhen par bskyangs na nges par sems ngo mi mthong ka med do// thun nyer gcig / gnyis pa ngo sprod pa ni/ blta tshul dang po de bzhin byas pas gnas 'gyu sems kyi ngo bo de stong rkyang yang ma yin/ gnas pa'i ngang nas kha dog dbyibs sogs 'di 'dra snyam pa'i ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal le sing nge bde 'bol le ba ngag tu smra mi shes pa ngo shes shing thag chod pa zhig gi gsal stong ngos bzung med pa gcig 'dug zer na/ go ba yin na gru la mi thub pas cang mi yong*/ nang nas shar ba yin na/ 'o de ni gnas pa la lhag mthong shar ba yin pas gnas thog nas ngo bo mthong ba yin la/

de nyid (97)nyams bzang dus dang ngan dus thams cad kyi cha yang yang blta zhing gsal 'debs/ gnas pa nag thom me pa'i skyon can de ma yin par gsal hrig ge rjen pa rnam rtog gi mtshan ma thams cad rang sar zhi nas dge ba'i ngo bor rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas skyon med lhan ne bde 'bol le smra brjod dang bral zhing nyams su myong rgyu yod pa de nyid kyi ngang du bzhag cing bltas pas skye 'gags kha dogs dbyibs dang bral ba rtogs shing de skad snyam pa'i skad de ba de yang med la skye 'gags dang bral bar shes rgyu yod pa zhig 'dug par rtogs pa ni rtogs med las lhag mthong shar ba yin par shes par bya'o// thun nyer gnyis/ blta tshul gnyis pa ltar byas pas rnam rtog 'gyus pa thams cad stong pa skye 'gags dang bral bar 'dug na stong skad yin/ rjes med du shig ge 'gro 'dug na cung zad shar ba yin/ ngos bzung mi 'dug snyam pa'i skad de pha yang med la gsal med 'dzin med du ngos bzung med par shar grol dus mnyam na ngo 'phrod pa yin zhing*/ gzhan yang rtog pa rtogs pa'i yul gnas dus dang*/ 'gyu dus kyi sems sngar gyi rtog pa sogs la'ang bzang ngan dang*/ khyad par cung zad med par gsal rig rjen par rtogs pa dang*/ rtog pa tshur bkug pa'i rjes sam/ rtog pa yal ba'i rjes su gsal stong du song ba ma yin par thol skyes kyi rtog pa gsal stong du rtogs na ngo 'phrod pa yin pas/ da rtog pa 'gyus pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ rtog pa rang gi ngo bo gsum ka gsal stong du rjen ne 'dug pas/ rtog pa dang mi rtog pa gnyis ngo ma shes par yid kyi sgro btags nas bzung ba las khyad par du bya ba cung zad kyang med/ de sngon rtog pa ngo ma shes pas sgom dus song zhing ma rig pa yin/ de ngo shes na rtog pa kho rang sgom dang ye shes su (98)'du ba// da sgom gyi rtsa ba rtog pa la gyis// de snga rtog pa kho rang gis kho rang bsgribs nas ma mthong ba yin/

de mi rtog pa'i steng du sgom pa las khyad par 'phags pa rtog pa'i steng du sgom shes pa yin pas gang shar ba'i rtog pa de ngos zin par gyis la rtog pa ma skyes na ma skyes pa'i ngang du zhog spro mi dgos/ skyes na skyes pa'i ngang der zhog la bsdu mi dgos re dogs kyi bsam pa gang yang mi byed par/ sgom gyi ngo bo rtog pa rang la gyis dang*/ rtog pa de sems las ma 'das/ sems de ni rang grol ngo bo gsal stong rjen pa chos kyi sku grol bya grol byed dang bral ba yin pas/ de ltar rtogs pa ni rtog pa la lhag mthong shar ba yin pas gsal stong zung 'jug chos skur ngo 'phrod pa yin no// mdor na gang shar ngo shes par byas nas de nyid kyi steng du ma bcos shing ma yengs par bzhag go / thun nyer gsum/ snang thog nas bltas pas yul de'ang sal le ma 'gags pa de la lta byed kyi sems de'ang 'dzin med du thal le ba/ yul de yang pha gir 'dug snyam pa'i skad de ba de yang med pa bu chung lha khang la blta ba lta bu dang*/ snang ba yul med lhang nge ba/ snang sems gnyis tha dad med par sems kyi rang mdangs ma 'gags par snang ba/ sems las snang ba gud du song ba'am/ yul gzhan zhig tu grub pa med par gsal stong du shar ba na/ de ni snang ba la lhag mthong shar ba yin pas de snang stong zung 'jug chos skur shes par bya'o//

thun nyer bzhi/ lus sems gnyis la de ltar bltas pas de gnyis gcig dang tha dad gang yang ma yin par gsal stong zung 'jug chu nang gi zla ba lta bu tsha grang sogs chor bar snang ba snang stong du ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis bag chags mthu brtas pas sems kyis btags nas 'dzin pa 'thas pa ma gtogs don du grub par lus sems gang gis tshor (99)sogs kyi gdags gzhi dang bral bar snang ba zhig la legs par gtad/ gzir nas bltas pas rang log tu song*/ snang ba 'dzin med du lhang nge ba zhig yong bas de'i dus na rang dang snang ba snang stong yul med du lhang nge 'dug na/ de gnas lugs kyi rang babs sam/ sems kyi mtshan nyid yin zhing*/ rang dang snang ba sems rnams thams cad sems/ sems kyang rang mdangs ma gtogs gzhan du grub pa cung zad kyang med pas lus sems kyang dbyer med sems kho nas btags nas bzhag pa tsam du zad pa'o// thun nyer lnga/ gnas 'gyu gnyis la de ltar bltas pas de gnyis las rnam rtog sgom du shes nas/ gnas 'gyu gnyis la gcig las med par shes/ 'char lugs re mos su 'char zhing gnas dus su mi 'gyu/ 'gyu dus mi gnas/ byed mkhan sems gcig pus byed par 'dug cing gnyis po 'di'i ngo bo gsal stong rjen pa de las ma 'das/ de'ang rtog pa tshur bkug nas gsal stong rjen par mthong ba min par thog ma'i thol skyes kyi rtog pa de ka gsal stong rjen par rtogs na/ sems kyi gnas lugs shes shing gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel zer ba yin pas sems mi rtog pa la gsal lhan ne gnas sam rtog pa 'gyus sam/ rtog pa kho rang gi ngo bo rnams gsal stong rjen pa de las ma 'das so// da yul snang ba thams cad chu dang rlabs ltar thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul las don du gang yang ma grub par rtogs pa na snang ba thams cad sems su ngo 'phrod pa yin/ sems de'i ngo bo 'gro gnas 'byung gsum la dpyad pas gang du'ang ma grub par rmi lam gyi rta glang ltar don la ma grub par rtogs pa sems stong par ngo 'phrod/

stong zhing gsal dwangs kyi ngang nas 'gags med bde chen sna tshogs lhun grub tu 'char ba chu nang (100)gi zla ba ltar rtogs pas stong pa lhun grub tu ngo 'phrod pa yin/ de ltar lhun gyis grub tsam nas gsal rig stong pa lhun grub spros bral 'gyur med bde ba chen po las ma g.yos par sbrul la mdud pa bor ba ltar shar grol dus mnyam par nges pas lhun grub rang grol du ngo 'phrod pa yin/ ngo sprod rgyu'i sems de ni tha mal shes pa mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu rig rig tur tur po 'di ka gsal stong zung 'jug bde ba chen po rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid ces sam/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya bas de ngo shes na phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa zer ba yin pas de la sgom rgyu ci yang med par skad cig kyang ma yengs par rig pa hrig ger rang sar bzhag /legs su re ba dang nyes dogs pa'i re dogs gang yang mi bya bar lhod glod la tha mal shes pa'i rang ngo bskyangs pas skad cig de la phyag rgya chen po bde stong zung 'jug de sprin med kyi nam mkha' dag pa'i dkyil ltar mthong ba yin no// da zhi lhag zung du 'brel zhing nyams rtogs phul du byung ste thar pa'i lam du tshud pa yin go bcad/ mdor na gnyis 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa thams cad dang bral ba'i gnyis med ye shes spros bral bde ba chen po rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba de ngo 'phrod pa yin/ de'ang mos gus can la lding*/ gdung shugs can gsol ba 'debs pa la 'khor/ byin rlabs zhugs pa la 'babs pa yin la/ ma sbas par rang chas su rang la yod par de sngar ngo ma shes/ da ngo 'phrod pa yin pas gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i thog tu slebs/ lam phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo mthong*/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po gtan la phebs pa yin pas dga' ba sgom la dus rgyun du nan tan snying por byas te skyong ba gal che'o// 'di ngo sprod rnams dang blta tshul phyogs gcig tu byas/

de'i skye tshul dang bstun ngo sprod phyogs gcig tu byas la/ de (101)ltar ma byas par thog ma nas ngo sprod phyogs gcig tu byas na dred po chos rgyus can rting sor gzhan gyis khrid 'debs pa sogs la'ang na 'phar rgyu med par go ba skam por lus te gnod nyin yod pas 'di bzhin mthong tshul re dang bstun ngo sprod re gdab par bya'o// 'di ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o// thun nyer drug / gsum pa rjes ni bogs 'don zhing gegs bsal ba/ yon tan skye tshul dang*/ lam bgrod tshul/ 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul lo// dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas byang chub kyi sems sgom pa rnams la'ang phyag rgya chen po'i rtsis zin par bya zhing*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len kun la'ang de bzhin khyer so gsum dang ldan pa dang*/ spyod lam rnam bzhi kun tu'ang rang ro ngos bzung nas phyag rgya chen po dang bsre/ ma bcos spros pa dang bral ba'i zhi lhag dbyer med de nyid dang ma bral bar nyams su len/ de la brten nas spyod pa bzhi'i sgo nas bogs 'don/ gzhan yang dge mi dge'i spang blang la zhen pa dang*/ dus gsum ma grub pa la dus 'di tsam la 'tshang rgya'o snyam pa dang*/ rang sems gdod nas ye shes lnga dang ldan pa yin pa la tha mal du bzung ba dang*/ sgom byung gi shes rab gtso bor mi 'don par thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis grol bar 'dod pa ste/ yul dus ngo bo rang bzhin shes rab la log par rtog pa spangs te/ lus gnad legs par bca'/ gnas na gnas thog dang*/ 'phro na 'phro thog tu de'i ngo bo la bltas te bzhag pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang lus gnad gcig tu 'byams pa bsgyur cing dub pa spang ba dang*/ nyams rtogs bzang ngan gang la'ang chags sdang zhen pa spangs te/ dang por mgo rtsom pa dang*/ bar du 'phro gcod pa/ tha mar nyams skyong bar mkhas pa ste mkhas pa gsum la bslab bo// yang (102)bde gsal mi rtog pa sogs mdor na nyams rtogs gang la'ang zhen na gol zhing phung bas de bzhin chags sdang spang ngo*//

thun nyer gsum/ gcig du bral gyi rigs pa sogs kyis gtan la phab ste chos thams cad rang ngos stong par song ba blos byas kyi stong nyid gshis shor dang*/ stong pa nyid gnyen po dang*/ nyon mongs pa spang byar bzung ste/ thams cad stong pa nyid yin pa ma rtogs pa ste stong nyid gnyen por shor ba/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi lam thams cad sangs rgyas kyi lam yin par ma rtogs te stong nyid kho na ma gtogs gzhan gyi lam gyis go mi chod par blta ba thabs kyi cha la mi sems pa stong nyid lam shor dang*/ nyams su ma myong bar swa bhā ba sogs kyis stong nyid du sbyangs te thams cad la stong nyid kyis rgyas 'debs pas las 'bras khyad du gsod pa stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba ste shor sa bzhi spang bar bya'o// blos byas kyi stong nyid 'di rnams las dang po pa'i skabs su mi rung ba ma yin lam thar spang bar bya'o// de nas spang blang bsal bzhag dang bral bar gang shar gyi ngo bo 'dzin med lhug par skyong ba la brtson par bya'o// thun nyer brgyad/ yang rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa sogs sgom du dga' rab re shar yang rtog pa spun por song mi chun par drag por g.yo ba la brten nas sgyid lug /rtog pa dgrar langs kyi rnam rtog de nyid sku drin can du bltas la de nyid kyi ngang du 'dzin med du bzhag pas sel lo// nyon mongs pa dgrar langs dang*/ chos thams cad ma grub par mthong nas las rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa stong nyid dgrar langs dang*/ snang ba sna tshogs kyi mthong snang bkra lam me ba la zhen te de la ma bde ting nge ba snang ba dgrar langs dang*/ yang yon tan de dag cung zad dang ldan pas gzhan dad pa dang snying rje (103)stong nyid kyi yon tan de dag dang mi ldan par mthong nas de la snying rje skyes te 'di rnams kyi 'gro don bya'o snyam ste mi 'grub bzhin rang gi dge sbyor bskyur nas de la 'jug pa snying rje dgrar langs dang*/

lta ba gtan la ma phebs nas thams cad mkhyen pa byed do snyam du sgra tshad bzo sogs bya ba phran tshegs la 'jug cing ting nge 'dzin 'dor bar byed pa rgyu 'bras kyi rtog pa dgrar langs te lnga po 'di'ang de dag gi rtog pa nam skyes de ka'i ngo bo la bltas te spang blang dgag sgrub med par bskyangs pas sel lo// de bzhin sgom skyon bying rgod rmugs gsum sogs skyon dang*/ nad dang gdon dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs dang slong tshad na tsha sdug bsngal nyams rtogs khyad par can sogs ji ltar byung yang chags sdang spangs te de ka'i ngo bo la bltas te rang babs su bzhag pas rang zhir 'gro'o// yang na rnam rtog nad gdon gegs sogs kyi skye gnas 'gro gsum kha dog dbyibs sogs la blta/ yang na nad sogs la gtong len bya/ yang na nad sogs sna tshogs su 'char ba sprul sku/ rig la longs sku/ stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid sku/ de gsum dbyer med pa chos kyi skur blta'o// 'di ni gegs sel bogs 'don sbrags pa'o// gzhan gegs sel bogs 'don mang yang 'di tsam du 'dus so// thun nyer dgu/ gnyis pa yon tan skye tshul dang lam bgrod tshul ni/ sngon 'gro la gnad du bsnun nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang mi rtag pa bsgoms pas tshe 'di la blo log /las 'bras kyis de la yid ches te srog dang bsngos nas bsrung*/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyis 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes te nges par 'byung zhing byang chub thob 'dod/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas rang bde 'dod dang bral nas (104)gzhan don kho na sgrub/ yig brgyas sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags dngos nyams dang rmi lam sogs su 'byung zhing nyams rtogs skye/ maṇ+ḍal gyis lus sems bde/ 'dod pa chung*/ chog shes/ bsod nams dpag med thob/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis mos gus 'bar/ ting nge 'dzin dang byin rlabs nyams rtogs rtsol med du skye'o// zhi gnas kyis lus shin sbyangs thob/

mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dang ldan zhing zas gos la sred pa chung bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa sogs mtha' yas so// lhag mthong gis sa bcu lam lnga bgrod nas sgom med kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// thun sum cu pa'o// lam bgrod tshul yang 'dir rtse gcig /spros bral/ ro gcig /sgom med che 'bring chung gsum rnams bgrod par 'gyur ba las/ dang po ni/ sems zhi gnas la cung zad brtan pa/ rab tu brtan pa/ shin tu brtan pa'i rim pas rtse gcig che 'bring chung gsum gyi lam bgrod/ gnyis pa ni/ de goms pa brtan pas chos thams cad spros pa dang bral bar rtogs/ sgom dran 'dzin la cher ma ltos par/ spros bral cung zad shar ba/ rab tu shar ba/ shin tu shar ba/ mi brtan pa dang*/ cung zad brtan pa/ rab tu brtan pa'i dbang gis spros bral chung 'bring che gsum gyi lam bgrod/ gsum pa ni/ chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu cung zad rtogs pa dang*/ rab tu rtogs pa dang*/ shin tu rtogs pas sngar gyi stong zhen de dag pa las mi brtan pa dang*/ cung zad brtan pa dang*/ shin tu brtan pa'i dbang las ro gcig chung 'bring che gsum bgrod/ bzhi pa ni/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba cung zad rtogs pa/ rab tu rtogs pa/ shin tu rtogs pas sngar snang thog tu bde/ rjes shes kyi dran 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu de dang yang bral bam mi brtan pa dang*/ cung zad brtan pa dang*/ shin tu brtan pa'i dbang las sgom med chung 'bring che gsum bgrod de rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs (105)te sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par 'gyur ro// gsum pa 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul yang*/ de ltar bsgoms pas rtse gcig nas sgom med chen po'i bar bgrod de mngon par sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don rgyun chad med par mdzad cing thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i phrin las khyab pa dang rtag pa'i bdag nyid can lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro// des na 'di tsam la gnad du bsnun nas sgom skyes bdag po med par ma song na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya nges so// des na kaṃ tshang lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes grags pa'i dmigs rim mdor bsdus dmigs thun dang sbrags zin bris su bgyis pa yin cing*/

'di la 'gal 'khrul byung na bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol lo// dge ba gang yod mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad tshe gcig la phyag rgya chen po rtogs nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes pa 'di lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho ba/ dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs sras su gyur pa'i gu'i gung pa nang so mchod sprin pas dgos zhes bskul bar brten zin thun du sku rab bkra shis sgang nas badz+re shwa ras bris shing spel ba'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar nyams rtogs 'bar zhing bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyan du byon/ thun sum cu so gcig yod/ shu bha mastu sarba dza ga ta mi daṃ// (106)
